  `claim_remarks` text COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci,

  `found_id` int unsigned NOT NULL,
  `processed_by` int unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `processed_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `processing_remarks` text COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci,
  `approved_found_id` int unsigned GENERATED ALWAYS AS ((case when (`status` = _utf8mb4'APPROVED') then `found_id` else NULL end)) STORED,
  PRIMARY KEY (`claim_id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_claim_user_found` (`submitted_by`,`found_id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_claim_approved_found` (`approved_found_id`),
  KEY `fk_claim_found_item` (`found_id`),
  KEY `fk_claim_processor` (`processed_by`),
  KEY `idx_claim_status` (`status`),
  KEY `idx_claim_user_created` (`submitted_by`,`created_at`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_claim_found_item` FOREIGN KEY (`found_id`) REFERENCES `found_item` (`found_id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_claim_processor` FOREIGN KEY (`processed_by`) REFERENCES `user` (`user_id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_claim_submitter` FOREIGN KEY (`submitted_by`) REFERENCES `user` (`user_id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `chk_claim_description` CHECK ((char_length(trim(`claim_description`)) >= 10)),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_claim_process_relationship` CHECK (((`processed_by` is not null) or ((`processed_at` is null) and (`processing_remarks` is null)))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_claim_processing_status` CHECK (((upper(trim(`status`)) = _utf8mb4'PENDING') or (`processed_by` is not null))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_claim_status` CHECK ((upper(trim(`status`)) in (_utf8mb4'PENDING',_utf8mb4'APPROVED',_utf8mb4'REJECTED')))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

CREATE TABLE `match` (
  `match_id` int unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,

  `status` varchar(30) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `matched_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `reviewed_by` int unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `reviewed_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `review_remarks` text COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci,
  `accepted_lost_id` int unsigned GENERATED ALWAYS AS ((case when (`status` = _utf8mb4'ACCEPTED') then `lost_id` else NULL end)) STORED,
  `accepted_found_id` int unsigned GENERATED ALWAYS AS ((case when (`status` = _utf8mb4'ACCEPTED') then `found_id` else NULL end)) STORED,
  `lost_revision` int unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  `found_revision` int unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  PRIMARY KEY (`match_id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_match_pair` (`lost_id`,`found_id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_match_accepted_lost` (`accepted_lost_id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_match_accepted_found` (`accepted_found_id`),
  KEY `fk_match_found_item` (`found_id`),
  KEY `fk_match_reviewer` (`reviewed_by`),
  KEY `idx_match_similarity` (`similarity_score`),
  KEY `idx_match_status` (`status`),
  KEY `idx_match_lost_status` (`lost_id`,`status`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_match_found_item` FOREIGN KEY (`found_id`) REFERENCES `found_item` (`found_id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_match_lost_item` FOREIGN KEY (`lost_id`) REFERENCES `lost_item` (`lost_id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_match_reviewer` FOREIGN KEY (`reviewed_by`) REFERENCES `user` (`user_id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `chk_match_method` CHECK ((upper(trim(`match_method`)) in (_utf8mb4'AI',_utf8mb4'MANUAL',_utf8mb4'HYBRID'))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_match_review_relationship` CHECK (((`reviewed_by` is not null) or ((`reviewed_at` is null) and (`review_remarks` is null)))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_match_review_status` CHECK (((upper(trim(`status`)) = _utf8mb4'PENDING') or (`reviewed_by` is not null))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_match_similarity_score` CHECK (((`similarity_score` >= 0) and (`similarity_score` <= 1))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_match_status` CHECK ((upper(trim(`status`)) in (_utf8mb4'PENDING',_utf8mb4'ACCEPTED',_utf8mb4'REJECTED')))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

views.name: vw_recovery_dashboard
views.definition: select `c`.`category_id` AS `category_id`,`c`.`category_name` AS `category_name`,(select count(0) from `clf_doc_1790910645129`.`lost_item` `li` where (`li`.`category_id` = `c`.`category_id`)) AS `lost_reports`,(select count(0) from `clf_doc_1790910645129`.`found_item` `fi` where (`fi`.`category_id` = `c`.`category_id`)) AS `found_reports`,(select count(0) from (`clf_doc_1790910645129`.`claim` `cl` join `clf_doc_1790910645129`.`found_item` `fi` on((`fi`.`found_id` = `cl`.`found_id`))) where ((`fi`.`category_id` = `c`.`category_id`) and (`cl`.`status` = 'APPROVED'))) AS `recovered_items` from `clf_doc_1790910645129`.`category` `c`

views.name: vw_user_lost_summary
views.definition: select `u`.`user_id` AS `user_id`,`u`.`email` AS `email`,concat_ws(' ',`u`.`first_name`,`u`.`middle_name`,`u`.`last_name`) AS `full_name`,count(`li`.`lost_id`) AS `total_lost_reports`,sum((case when (`li`.`status` = 'OPEN') then 1 else 0 end)) AS `open_reports`,sum((case when (`li`.`status` = 'MATCHED') then 1 else 0 end)) AS `matched_reports`,sum((case when (`li`.`status` = 'CLOSED') then 1 else 0 end)) AS `closed_reports`,(select count(0) from `clf_doc_1790910645129`.`notification` `n` where ((`n`.`user_id` = `u`.`user_id`) and (`n`.`is_read` = 0))) AS `unread_notifications` from (`clf_doc_1790910645129`.`user` `u` left join `clf_doc_1790910645129`.`lost_item` `li` on((`li`.`reported_by` = `u`.`user_id`))) group by `u`.`user_id`,`u`.`email`,`u`.`first_name`,`u`.`middle_name`,`u`.`last_name`
